responsibility: Defines the builder interface for lowering Rust intrinsics and related backend-specific primitive operations, including fallback signaling to intrinsic default bodies and hooks for assumptions, trap/abort, CFI type tests, and variadic argument setup/teardown.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/intrinsic.rs`, which implements the shared intrinsic-dispatch and lowering logic, this file defines the builder interface that backends must provide for primitive intrinsic operations such as abort, assume, type tests, variadics, and backend-specific intrinsic fallback handling.
